method: Whole files read and pinned Git blobs verified; original fetcher executed after TypeScript-only signature erasure with local mocked HTTP500 JSON response.
findings: fetcher never checks response.ok; local control confirmed HTTP500 JSON fulfills with error object. Generic JSON type does not validate the payload.

Progress consumes value but does not pass it to Radix Root; indicator transform uses value. Source shows visual/accessibility state can diverge; actual Radix render not executed. No explicit range clamp.
useMedia listens to window resize rather than MediaQueryList change; non-resize query updates may be missed. Listener cleanup exists. Browser behavior not executed.
useIntersect disconnects observer on cleanup and supports freeze-on-visible. Its dependencies track ref identity rather than current node; replacing node alone may not rerun effect.
Remaining files are statistical data declarations, class merging and presentation wrappers. CardTitle ref type names paragraph while rendered element is h3; no runtime defect asserted.
limits: No upstream Jest or browser execution. pHash/ASAN deferred.
